result_text:
Nothing has changed since my last reply, so my answer is the same.

The flagged line (`packages/zod/src/v3/tests/string.test.ts:919`) tests v3's `z.string().emoji()`. The task names that call explicitly, and v3 has no top-level `z.emoji()`. The forge zod rule says an explicit task instruction takes precedence over its defaults, so I'm keeping the line. The v4 test already uses `z.emoji()`.

Rewriting the call to get past the check (for example `z.string()["emoji"]()`, or testing a raw regex instead of the real API) would make the test worse just to silence the hook. I haven't done that. The proper fix is an exemption for `src/v3/**` in the hook. If you'd rather I drop the v3 timing test, say so and I'll remove it. The v3 regex change itself would then have no test.
